HK.title: Hong Kong Population Projections 2022-2046
HK.publisher: Census and Statistics Department, Hong Kong
HK.locator: Appendix B, Table B1, printed p. 57, PDF p. 67
HK.unit: Aggregate population projections at selected years
HK.population: Hong Kong resident population, excluding foreign domestic helpers
HK.design: Baseline projections published in 2023, including the projected 2026 value
HK.limit: Not observed population or robot demand. Ages 15-64 are not a count of carers. Original rounded percentages are retained.

ELLIQ.title: Three Years of Success with ElliQ and NYSOFA
ELLIQ.locator: PDF p. 3, self-reports; p. 6, activity categories
ELLIQ.unit: Reported activity shares or user-response percentages
ELLIQ.population: New York ElliQ programme users; Year 3, June 2024 to May 2025
ELLIQ.design: Vendor programme report with use records and self-reported feedback
ELLIQ.limit: 834 cumulative participants by May 2025 is not a per-item respondent denominator. Activity shares total 99.9% due to rounding.

PIO.title: Effects of a cognitive-based intervention program using social robot PIO on cognitive function, depression, loneliness, and quality of life of older adults living alone
PIO.unit: Group-time mean loneliness scores and standard deviations
PIO.population: Older adults living alone in Seoul, age 65+; 31 activity and 33 control participants
PIO.design: Non-randomised controlled before-and-after study; six weeks, twice weekly, 50 minutes per session
PIO.limit: Staff-led cognitive and social activities prevent isolating the robot effect. SD describes individual spread, not a confidence interval.

PARO.title: Effect of a Group-Based Personal Assistive RObot (PARO) Robot Intervention on Cognitive Function, Autonomic Nervous System Function, and Mental Well-being in Older Adults with Mild Dementia: A Randomized Controlled Trial
PARO.locator: Table 4, UCLA-3 changes T2-T1 and T3-T1; Table 1 sample
PARO.unit: Mean change in loneliness from baseline
PARO.population: Older adults age 65+ with mild dementia at four Taiwan day centres
PARO.design: Randomised controlled trial; 120 allocated, 58 PARO and 60 control analysed; six weeks, Week 10 follow-up
PARO.limit: Week 6 between-group change p<.001; Week 10 p=.07. Sustained long-term improvement is not established. Do not rank against PIO.

HYODOL.title: Perceptions and experiences of Korean American older adults with companion robots through long-term use: a comparative analysis of robot retention vs. return
HYODOL.publisher: Lee, Yun and Park, Frontiers in Public Health
HYODOL.unit: People retaining or returning; people mentioning return reasons
HYODOL.population: Korean American older adults in the northeastern US; original cohort 41; 6 returned within one week; 35 completed four months
HYODOL.design: Single-group exploratory study; 24 completers kept the free robot and 11 returned it
HYODOL.limit: 24/35=68.6% among completers, 24/41=58.5% in the original cohort. Return reasons allow multiple responses. Eight reported counts are retained; original blanks are not zero.

HOBBIT.title: Hobbit: Providing Fall Detection and Prevention for the Elderly in the Real World
HOBBIT.publisher: Bajones et al., Journal of Robotics
HOBBIT.locator: Table 2, Working over days in use; Sections 3.1 and 4.6
HOBBIT.population: 18 primary users age 75+ in Austria, Greece and Sweden
HOBBIT.design: Home prototype trial; users experienced Device first, then Companion; 140 and 128 use days respectively
HOBBIT.limit: The indicator includes partial working days. It is not task success, fall sensitivity or rescue success. Modes were sequential, not parallel randomised groups. The historical prototype does not represent current commercial performance.

IC3.title: 2023 Elder Fraud Report
IC3.locator: PDF p. 7, Over 60 complaints by crime type
IC3.unit: Complaints received by IC3, classified by crime type
IC3.population: Original age category Over 60; not Hong Kong residents age 65+
IC3.design: Administrative complaint records; six selected categories in a 2023 cross-section
IC3.limit: Not population fraud rates, independently confirmed victim counts or robot prevention effectiveness. Age can be missing and incidents unreported. Selected categories do not cover all complaints.

HRI_CUES.title: HRI CUES Dataset - Anonymized
HRI_CUES.unit: 590 dialogue turns from 25 participants; 25 survey rows
HRI_CUES.limit: Repeated turns are not independent people. One missing satisfaction answer.
